name: Fixed Shot
plain: The frame stays completely still and lets the subject "act" — all attention concentrates on action and expression.
when: Dialogue, monologue, building emotion, product stills, documentary content
templateZh: 固定机位，【景别】，画面保持静止不动。【人物/物体+正在做什么】，【环境和光线】，【画面风格】。
templateEn: Fixed camera position, [shot size], the frame holds completely still. [subject + what they are doing], [environment and light], [visual style].
exampleZh: 固定机位，近景，画面保持静止不动。老人坐在藤椅上翻看一本泛黄的相册，手指轻轻抚过照片上的面孔，阳台午后的阳光斜斜地照在他满是皱纹的手上，温暖怀旧的色调，生活纪实感。
exampleEn: Fixed camera position, medium close-up, the frame holds completely still. An elderly man sits in a rattan chair leafing through a yellowed photo album, his fingers gently brushing across the faces in the photographs; afternoon sunlight from the balcony slants over his wrinkled hands, warm nostalgic tones, slice-of-life documentary feel.
lesson: In photography, stillness itself is emphasis: the steadier the camera, the more attention goes to the action and expression in frame. Next time you shoot dialogue or emotion, write camera holds still first, then what the person is doing — the simplest opening often wears best.

name: Fixed Shot
plain: The frame stays completely still and lets the subject "act" — all attention concentrates on action and expression.
when: Dialogue, monologue, building emotion, product stills, documentary content
templateZh: 固定机位，【景别】，画面保持静止不动。【人物/物体+正在做什么】，【环境和光线】，【画面风格】。
templateEn: Fixed camera position, [shot size], the frame holds completely still. [subject + what they are doing], [environment and light], [visual style].
exampleZh: 固定机位，特写，画面保持静止不动。一杯刚倒好的手冲咖啡放在原木桌上，表面的油脂光圈缓缓扩散，蒸汽袅袅升起在逆光中清晰可见，侧面窗光，咖啡馆氛围，广告质感。
exampleEn: Fixed camera position, close-up, the frame holds completely still. A freshly poured cup of hand-drip coffee sits on an oak table, the crema slowly spreading into rings, steam curling upward clearly visible against the backlight, side window light, café atmosphere, commercial-ad polish.
lesson: For products, don't rush to move the camera — a still-life close-up plus a wisp of backlit steam is enough to look premium. Remember the universal formula: still object + micro-motion (steam / light flares / droplets) + backlight = instant commercial polish.

name: Dolly In / Push In
plain: The frame closes in on the subject from afar, telling the audience "look here — this is what matters."
when: Highlighting detail, rising emotion, revealing suspense, magnifying a product's selling point
templateZh: 【速度：缓慢/匀速/快速】推镜头，画面从【起始景别】向前推进至【结束景别】。【主体和动作】，随着画面靠近【发生什么变化】，【背景/景深变化】，【情绪和风格】。
templateEn: [Speed: slow / steady / fast] dolly-in, the frame pushes forward from [starting shot size] to [ending shot size]. [Subject and action], as the camera closes in [what changes], [background / depth-of-field change], [mood and style].
exampleZh: 推镜头，画面从全景向前推进至眼部大特写。深夜书房里一个男人坐在桌前凝视着面前的一封信，随着画面靠近逐渐看到他眼眶泛红眼角有泪光闪烁，背景书架逐渐虚化，只剩他的眼睛和那封信，沉重压抑的氛围。
exampleEn: Dolly-in, the frame pushes forward from a wide shot to an extreme close-up of the eyes. In a study late at night, a man sits at his desk staring at a letter in front of him; as the camera closes in, his reddened eyes and the glint of tears come into view, the bookshelves behind gradually defocusing until only his eyes and the letter remain, a heavy, suffocating mood.
lesson: Push-in = camera approaches = emphasis, just like leaning in to look closer. To spotlight something, write camera slowly pushes in on XXX, then state exactly where the push ends (e.g., pushing in to an eye close-up) and the AI gets it in one take.

name: Dolly In / Push In
plain: The frame closes in on the subject from afar, telling the audience "look here — this is what matters."
when: Highlighting detail, rising emotion, revealing suspense, magnifying a product's selling point
templateZh: 【速度：缓慢/匀速/快速】推镜头，画面从【起始景别】向前推进至【结束景别】。【主体和动作】，随着画面靠近【发生什么变化】，【背景/景深变化】，【情绪和风格】。
templateEn: [Speed: slow / steady / fast] dolly-in, the frame pushes forward from [starting shot size] to [ending shot size]. [Subject and action], as the camera closes in [what changes], [background / depth-of-field change], [mood and style].
exampleZh: 匀速推镜头，画面从中景向前推进至微距特写。一支口红缓缓旋转露出膏体，随着画面靠近逐渐看清膏体表面细腻的丝绒纹理和微闪光泽，背景完全虚化只剩一片柔和的粉色光晕，奢侈品广告质感。
exampleEn: Steady dolly-in, the frame pushes forward from a medium shot to a macro close-up. A lipstick slowly twists up to reveal the bullet; as the camera closes in, the fine velvet texture and subtle shimmer on its surface become clear, the background fully defocused into a soft pink halo, luxury-ad polish.
lesson: The golden three seconds of a product video: push from medium shot to macro close-up, saving material details (velvet texture, subtle shimmer) for the final reveal. Whatever you're selling, give its detail the last frame — that's "endpoint thinking."

name: Dolly Out / Pull Out
plain: The frame retreats from close to the subject, revealing a bigger world — "so this is where they are."
when: Environment reveals, expressing smallness / loneliness, uplifting endings, micro-to-macro
templateZh: 拉镜头，画面从【主体的近景/特写】向后缓缓退开。随着画面拉远，逐步揭示出【周围环境一层一层展开】，最终画面变为【最远处的全景画面】，【情绪和风格】。
templateEn: Dolly-out, the frame pulls slowly back from [a close-up of the subject]. As the camera retreats, [the surrounding environment is revealed layer by layer], until the frame becomes [the widest full shot], [mood and style].
exampleZh: 拉镜头，画面从一只手在桌子上轻轻放下一朵花的特写向后缓缓退开。随着画面拉远，逐步揭示出这是一个公园石凳前站着的一个女生，再远一些是一整片公园被春天的氛围覆盖，最终画面变为航拍俯视这片宁静的山坡。
exampleEn: Dolly-out, the frame pulls slowly back from a close-up of a hand gently laying a flower down on a table. As the frame widens, it gradually reveals a young woman standing before a stone bench in a park, then farther out a whole park wrapped in spring, and finally an aerial view looking down over this tranquil hillside.
lesson: A dolly-out is the answer reveal: show the part first, then tell the audience how big the world is. Try ending a vlog by pulling from "the object in hand" out to "the whole environment" — viewers feel a satisfying "so that's it" unfold.

name: Dolly Out / Pull Out
plain: The frame retreats from close to the subject, revealing a bigger world — "so this is where they are."
when: Environment reveals, expressing smallness / loneliness, uplifting endings, micro-to-macro
templateZh: 拉镜头，画面从【主体的近景/特写】向后缓缓退开。随着画面拉远，逐步揭示出【周围环境一层一层展开】，最终画面变为【最远处的全景画面】，【情绪和风格】。
templateEn: Dolly-out, the frame pulls slowly back from [a close-up of the subject]. As the camera retreats, [the surrounding environment is revealed layer by layer], until the frame becomes [the widest full shot], [mood and style].
exampleZh: 拉镜头，画面从宇航员头盔面罩的特写向后缓缓退开。面罩上反射着蓝色星球的倒影，随着画面拉远逐步揭示出他正独自漂浮在无垠的太空中，远处是缓慢旋转的空间站残骸，最终画面变为广阔的星空全景中一个渺小的人影，孤独与壮美并存。
exampleEn: Dolly-out, the frame pulls slowly back from a close-up of an astronaut's helmet visor, a blue planet reflected in it. As the frame widens it gradually reveals him drifting alone in boundless space, the slowly tumbling wreckage of a space station in the distance, until he is a tiny figure in a vast star-field panorama — loneliness and grandeur in one frame.
lesson: To convey smallness, use a pull-back plus environmental contrast: the person shrinks, the background grows, and loneliness emerges naturally. That sci-fi poster look comes exactly from this.

name: Pan Shot
plain: The frame sweeps side to side like slowly turning your head where you stand, unveiling a space piece by piece.
when: Showing a full space, sweeping across a row of objects / people, tracking horizontally moving subjects
templateZh: 水平摇镜，画面从【方向】向【方向】缓慢平移。依次扫过【内容A】、【内容B】、【内容C】，最终停留在【视觉落点】，【光线和风格】。
templateEn: Pan shot, the camera drifts slowly from [direction] toward [direction]. It sweeps across [element A], [element B], [element C], and finally settles on [the visual resting point], [light and style].
exampleZh: 水平摇镜，画面从右向左缓慢平移。依次扫过日式居酒屋的吧台全景：陈列整齐的清酒瓶、冒着热气的关东煮锅、正在切刺身的老板娘专注的侧脸，最终停留在一位独坐角落小酌的年轻人身上，暖色灯光配合木质装修，深夜食堂氛围。
exampleEn: Pan shot, the camera drifts slowly from right to left. It sweeps across the full counter of a Japanese izakaya: neatly ranked sake bottles, a steaming oden pot, the owner's focused profile as she slices sashimi, and finally settles on a young man drinking alone in the corner, warm lamplight over wood furnishings, midnight-diner atmosphere.
lesson: A pan is like turning your head in place: one end opens, the other lands the point. The trick is to lock down "where it finally stops" — the audience's eyes follow the lens, and the landing point becomes the focus.

name: Pan Shot
plain: The frame sweeps side to side like slowly turning your head where you stand, unveiling a space piece by piece.
when: Showing a full space, sweeping across a row of objects / people, tracking horizontally moving subjects
templateZh: 水平摇镜，画面从【方向】向【方向】缓慢平移。依次扫过【内容A】、【内容B】、【内容C】，最终停留在【视觉落点】，【光线和风格】。
templateEn: Pan shot, the camera drifts slowly from [direction] toward [direction]. It sweeps across [element A], [element B], [element C], and finally settles on [the visual resting point], [light and style].
exampleZh: 水平摇镜，画面从左向右缓慢平移。依次扫过老教室的课桌：刻满字的桌面、翻开的课本、一个纸飞机、被风吹动的窗帘，最终停留在黑板上用粉笔写的"毕业快乐"四个字，午后阳光透过窗户洒满教室，怀旧青春感。
exampleEn: Pan shot, the camera drifts slowly from left to right. It sweeps across the desks of an old classroom: a tabletop carved with graffiti, an open textbook, a paper plane, curtains stirring in the wind, and finally settles on the chalk words "Happy Graduation" on the blackboard, afternoon sun pouring through the windows, nostalgic youthfulness.
lesson: Use a pan to tell "time": sweep across a string of old objects and land on one sentence or one word, and nostalgia clicks. The more specific the props (a carved desk, a paper plane), the truer the emotion.

name: Tilt Shot
plain: The frame moves up or down, revealing vertical layers of a space — climbing from the ground, or descending from the sky.
when: Showing height (buildings, mountains), introducing a character from feet to face, vertical spatial layers
templateZh: 垂直【向上/向下】摇镜，画面从【起始位置】缓缓移动至【终止位置】。依次经过【纵向内容描述】，最终停在【落点画面】，【风格】。
templateEn: Tilt [upward / downward], the camera moves slowly from [starting position] to [ending position]. It passes [vertical elements described in order], and finally rests on [the landing frame], [style].
exampleZh: 垂直向上摇镜，画面从地面的一双沾满泥巴的军靴缓缓向上移动。依次经过磨损的迷彩裤腿、挂着水壶的腰带、沾着灰尘的防弹背心、下巴上的胡茬，最终停在一双疲惫但坚毅的眼睛上，逆光剪影边缘泛着金色光晕，战争片质感。
exampleEn: Tilt upward, the camera rises slowly from a pair of mud-caked military boots on the ground. It climbs past frayed camouflage trouser legs, a belt hung with a canteen, a dust-covered flak vest, the stubble on a chin, and finally rests on a pair of exhausted yet resolute eyes, the backlit silhouette rimmed in a golden halo, war-film texture.
lesson: Don't open on the face — tilt up from the shoes and viewers assemble the character themselves. Boots, trousers, hands, face: reveal one layer per tilt. It's called the delayed reveal, far more ceremonial than showing the face first.

name: Tilt Shot
plain: The frame moves up or down, revealing vertical layers of a space — climbing from the ground, or descending from the sky.
when: Showing height (buildings, mountains), introducing a character from feet to face, vertical spatial layers
templateZh: 垂直【向上/向下】摇镜，画面从【起始位置】缓缓移动至【终止位置】。依次经过【纵向内容描述】，最终停在【落点画面】，【风格】。
templateEn: Tilt [upward / downward], the camera moves slowly from [starting position] to [ending position]. It passes [vertical elements described in order], and finally rests on [the landing frame], [style].
exampleZh: 垂直向上摇镜，画面从瀑布底部的水潭溅起的白色水花缓缓向上移动。依次经过飞流直下的水帘、布满青苔的岩壁、崖壁上生长的野花和藤蔓，最终停在瀑布顶端天空中一道彩虹横跨两岸，阳光穿透水雾形成丁达尔光线，自然纪录片质感。
exampleEn: Tilt upward, the camera rises slowly from the white spray bursting off the plunge pool at the waterfall's base. It climbs past the plunging curtain of water, moss-covered rock walls, wildflowers and vines clinging to the cliff, and finally rests on a rainbow arching across the sky at the falls' crest, sunlight piercing the mist into visible Tyndall beams, nature-documentary texture.
lesson: For mountains, waterfalls, skyscrapers, the vertical tilt delivers grandeur best: bottom-to-top makes height measurable. Spell out "what's at the bottom start and what's at the top end," or the AI will wander off course midway.

name: Follow Shot
plain: The frame moves in lockstep with the subject wherever they go, carrying a built-in sense of presence and companionship.
when: Walking / running characters, street exploration, chase scenes, immersive experiences
templateZh: 跟随镜头，画面从【方位：身后/侧面/前方】紧跟【主体】同步移动。【主体的动作】，周围【环境的动态变化】，【稳定性/手持感描述】，【风格】。
templateEn: Follow shot, the camera tracks [the subject] in sync from [position: behind / the side / up front]. [The subject's action], the surroundings [changing as they move], [stability / handheld feel], [style].
exampleZh: 跟随镜头，画面从侧后方紧跟一个女生同步移动。她走进一家开满鲜花的甜品店，推开玻璃门后满目粉白色系的花墙和展示柜映入眼帘，她边走边好奇地张望着橱窗里精致的蛋糕，柔和自然光，轻微手持感，小红书探店风格。
exampleEn: Follow shot, the camera tracks a young woman in sync from her side-rear. She steps into a dessert shop full of blossoms; pushing open the glass door, walls of pink-and-white flowers and display cases fill the view as she strolls along, curiously eyeing the exquisite cakes in the windows, soft natural light, a slight handheld feel, Xiaohongshu café-hop style.
lesson: The secret of a follow shot is sync: when camera and subject match speed, the viewer becomes "the person walking along." For shop visits, strolls, citywalk content, one line — follow shot from behind — creates instant immersion.

name: Follow Shot
plain: The frame moves in lockstep with the subject wherever they go, carrying a built-in sense of presence and companionship.
when: Walking / running characters, street exploration, chase scenes, immersive experiences
templateZh: 跟随镜头，画面从【方位：身后/侧面/前方】紧跟【主体】同步移动。【主体的动作】，周围【环境的动态变化】，【稳定性/手持感描述】，【风格】。
templateEn: Follow shot, the camera tracks [the subject] in sync from [position: behind / the side / up front]. [The subject's action], the surroundings [changing as they move], [stability / handheld feel], [style].
exampleZh: 跟随镜头，画面从正后方紧跟小女孩同步移动。她一个人提着灯笼穿过漆黑的竹林小路，灯笼的微弱橘色光只能照亮脚下一小片地面，两侧竹叶被风吹得沙沙作响阴影摇曳，手持感增加不安氛围，东方悬疑恐怖片质感。
exampleEn: Follow shot, the camera tracks a little girl in sync from directly behind. She walks alone carrying a lantern down a pitch-black bamboo path, its faint orange glow lighting only a small patch of ground at her feet, bamboo leaves rustling and shadows swaying in the wind on both sides, the handheld shake heightening the unease, Eastern suspense-horror texture.
lesson: Same follow shot, but behind reads tenser than in front — because you can't see the face. For horror-suspense remember: less information, more fear; add handheld shake and the unease doubles.

name: Circular Tracking Shot
plain: The frame arcs or spins 360 degrees around the subject, showcasing every angle with built-in ceremony and epic scale.
when: Character highlights, full product showcases, boss entrances, dance, big ceremonies
templateZh: 环绕镜头，画面围绕【主体】做【半圈/一圈/360度】【匀速/由慢到快】弧形旋转。【主体的状态和动作】，【环境和光效】，【风格】。
templateEn: Orbiting shot, the camera arcs [half a circle / a full circle / 360 degrees] around [the subject] at [steady / slow-to-fast] speed. [The subject's state and action], [environment and lighting effects], [style].
exampleZh: 环绕镜头，画面围绕芭蕾舞者做360度匀速弧形旋转。她在聚光灯下单脚立起脚尖做旋转定格姿态，白色纱裙展开如花朵绽放，镜头围绕她缓缓转一整圈，黑色背景只有一束顶光打在她身上，光影在地面画出完美圆形，极简高级感。
exampleEn: Orbiting shot, the camera makes a steady 360-degree arc around a ballet dancer. She rises onto pointe beneath a spotlight and holds a turning pose, her white tulle skirt blooming like a flower as the camera completes its slow full circle; against the black background a single top light falls on her, drawing a perfect circle of light on the floor, minimalist and refined.
lesson: An orbit shot carries a protagonist's halo — whoever the camera circles becomes the hero. Use it for highlight moments and entrances; add "steady 360 degrees" and the ceremony maxes out.

name: Circular Tracking Shot
plain: The frame arcs or spins 360 degrees around the subject, showcasing every angle with built-in ceremony and epic scale.
when: Character highlights, full product showcases, boss entrances, dance, big ceremonies
templateZh: 环绕镜头，画面围绕【主体】做【半圈/一圈/360度】【匀速/由慢到快】弧形旋转。【主体的状态和动作】，【环境和光效】，【风格】。
templateEn: Orbiting shot, the camera arcs [half a circle / a full circle / 360 degrees] around [the subject] at [steady / slow-to-fast] speed. [The subject's state and action], [environment and lighting effects], [style].
exampleZh: 环绕镜头，画面围绕一块机械腕表做360度由慢到快弧形旋转。腕表悬浮在半空中缓缓自转，每转到一个角度都能看到不同的光线在蓝宝石表镜和精钢表壳上折射出新的光斑，背景是纯黑色的深空质感，高端钟表广告风格。
exampleEn: Orbiting shot, the camera makes a 360-degree arc around a mechanical watch, accelerating from slow to fast. The watch floats in mid-air, slowly turning on its own; at every angle, new flares of light refract off the sapphire crystal and the steel case, against a pure-black deep-space background, high-end horological commercial style.
lesson: When orbiting a product, let light play the supporting role: a new flare at every angle makes it look expensive. Dark background + one floating product is the universal formula for high-end ads.

name: Crane Shot
plain: The frame rises or dives vertically in a big way — not "turning to look up" (that's a tilt) but the whole viewpoint riding an elevator up or plunging down.
when: Grand scene reveals, openings descending from sky to ground, endings rising from ground into clouds
templateZh: 升降镜头，画面从【起始高度】垂直【上升/下降】至【终止高度】。起初看到的是【起始画面】，随着高度变化逐渐展现出【中间过渡的视觉变化】，最终到达【终点画面】，【风格】。
templateEn: Crane shot, the frame rises / descends vertically from [starting height] to [ending height]. At first we see [the opening frame]; as the altitude changes, [the transitional visuals unfold], finally arriving at [the final frame], [style].
exampleZh: 升降镜头，画面从演唱会舞台中央女歌手的近景垂直上升至体育场顶部的鸟瞰高度。起初看到的是歌手举着话筒仰头高歌的激情画面，随着高度上升逐渐看到舞台灯光、挥舞荧光棒的万人观众席、整座体育场的椭圆形轮廓，最终到达夜空高度俯瞰全场如一颗发光的宝石嵌在城市夜景中，震撼壮阔。
exampleEn: Crane shot, the frame rises vertically from a close-up of the singer at the center of the stage up to a bird's-eye height above the stadium. At first we see her singing into the microphone, head thrown back in full voice; as the altitude climbs, the stage lights, ten thousand seats waving glow sticks, and the stadium's full oval come into view, until from night-sky height the whole arena glows like a jewel set into the city lights — vast and stirring.
lesson: The crane shot is drone-style awe: from one person to an entire city. Open on the person (emotion), end on the panorama (scale), let altitude change slowly between — and the emotion gains a slope.

name: Crane Shot
plain: The frame rises or dives vertically in a big way — not "turning to look up" (that's a tilt) but the whole viewpoint riding an elevator up or plunging down.

templateZh: 升降镜头，画面从【起始高度】垂直【上升/下降】至【终止高度】。起初看到的是【起始画面】，随着高度变化逐渐展现出【中间过渡的视觉变化】，最终到达【终点画面】，【风格】。
templateEn: Crane shot, the frame rises / descends vertically from [starting height] to [ending height]. At first we see [the opening frame]; as the altitude changes, [the transitional visuals unfold], finally arriving at [the final frame], [style].
exampleZh: 升降镜头，画面从云端高度垂直下降至地面。起初看到的是翻涌的白云和刺眼的阳光，随着高度下降穿破云层露出一片翠绿色的水稻田和蜿蜒的小河，继续下降看到田埂上一个戴斗笠的农民正在弯腰插秧，最终停在与他平视的高度，从壮阔到朴素的反差，田园诗意。
exampleEn: Crane shot, the frame descends vertically from cloud level down to the ground. At first we see churning white clouds and dazzling sunlight; breaking through the cloud layer reveals emerald rice paddies and a winding creek; descending further, a farmer in a bamboo hat bends to plant seedlings on a field ridge, and the camera finally stops at eye level with him — the vast meeting the humble, pastoral poetry.
lesson: Crane moves can also play contrast: descend from clouds into everyday life, and vast meeting humble becomes story. Remember the direction words: rise feels epic, descend grounds us — completely different emotions.

name: Dolly Zoom
plain: The most disorienting move — the subject stays the same size while the background stretches or squeezes as if pulled by an invisible hand; space breathes, the world warps. Built for inner shock.
when: Shock, fear, epiphany, a worldview collapsing, mental breakdown
templateZh: 希区柯克变焦效果。【主体】在画面中保持同样大小不变，背景发生强烈的透视【拉伸/挤压】变形。【主体的表情和状态】，【背景具体怎么变形】，【情绪氛围】。
templateEn: Dolly-zoom (Vertigo) effect. [The subject] stays exactly the same size in frame while the background undergoes a violent [stretched / squeezed] perspective distortion. [The subject's expression and state], [exactly how the background distorts], [emotional atmosphere].
exampleZh: 希区柯克变焦效果。女生站在地铁站台上在画面中保持同样大小不变，背景发生强烈的透视拉伸变形。她的表情从愣怔逐渐转为无法置信，身后的地铁隧道延伸好像要把整个世界吸走，荧光灯忽明忽暗，冷白色调混合隧道深处的暗绿，迷失感和不安感。
exampleEn: Dolly-zoom (Vertigo) effect. A young woman stands on the subway platform, staying exactly the same size in frame while the background stretches with violent perspective distortion. Her expression shifts from blank shock to disbelief, the tunnel behind her elongating as if to suck the whole world in, fluorescent lights flickering, cold white mixed with the deep green of the tunnel — vertigo and dread.
lesson: This is the "world warps, person doesn't" shot: subject fixed, background changing. Nail both points in the prompt (subject stays the same size + background stretches) or the AI will warp the whole frame — the exact pitfall the source file stresses.
tip: In a dolly-zoom prompt always state both "the subject stays unchanged" and "how the background changes," otherwise the AI easily distorts the entire frame and the technique loses its soul.

name: Long Take
plain: No cuts at all — the frame flows through the whole scene like an unbroken river, immersion at its purest.
when: Space roaming, continuous action, immersive exploration, narrative continuity
templateZh: 一镜到底，无剪切。画面从【起点】出发，【沿途路径：经过A → 穿过B → 转入C → 到达D】，全程连续流畅不间断，【风格】。
templateEn: One continuous long take, no cuts. The frame sets out from [starting point], [route: past A → through B → turns into C → arrives at D], flowing smoothly and unbroken throughout, [style].
exampleZh: 一镜到底，无剪切。画面从中药铺的雕花木门推入，经过柜台上一排排贴着手写标签的药柜抽屉，穿过珠帘进入后堂看到老药师正在铜秤上称量药材，镜头跟着他端着药碗转到隔壁房间递给床上的病人，全程连续流畅不间断，暖黄烛光，古装年代剧质感。
exampleEn: One continuous long take, no cuts. The frame pushes in through the carved wooden door of a traditional Chinese pharmacy, past row upon row of drawers labeled in handwritten script, through a bead curtain into the back room where the old pharmacist is weighing herbs on a brass scale, then follows him carrying the medicine bowl into the next room to hand it to the patient in bed, flowing smoothly and unbroken throughout, warm candlelight, period-drama texture.
lesson: One long take = walking the audience through it yourself. Write the route map (past A → through B → arrive at C) like giving directions, and the frame won't jump around; the more coherent the space, the deeper the immersion.

name: Whip Pan
plain: The frame whips away at extreme speed into motion blur, and when it settles it's already another picture. A natural scene-switcher and rhythm accelerator.
when: Fast scene jumps, urgency, time-lapse, twist reveals
templateZh: 快速甩镜，画面从【A画面】极速向【方向】甩出产生运动模糊，稳定后已切换为【B画面】，【节奏/情绪】。
templateEn: Whip pan: the frame whips out from [frame A] at extreme speed toward [direction] into motion blur; once it steadies, it has already switched to [frame B], [rhythm / emotion].
exampleZh: 快速甩镜，画面从少女对着镜子梳妆的侧脸极速向左甩出产生运动模糊，稳定后已切换为同一个女人三十年后对着同一面镜子化妆的画面——镜子里的脸多了皱纹但眼神更从容，一甩之间三十年，温柔的时间流逝感。
exampleEn: Whip pan: the frame whips out from a girl's profile at her vanity mirror, streaking left into motion blur; once it steadies, it is the same woman thirty years later doing her makeup at the same mirror — more lines on the face in the glass, but a calmer gaze. Thirty years in one flick, a tender sense of time passing.
lesson: The whip pan is the universal transition: one flick swaps the scene before viewers can leave it. The magic is making frames A and B echo (say, the same mirror) — then the flick stops being a cut and becomes time itself.

name: Bird's-Eye View
plain: Looking straight down from above, everything flattens into pattern. The god's-eye view brings omniscience, order, and geometric beauty.
when: Explaining layouts, showing arrangement / pattern beauty, food plating, crowds / cities, opening establishing shots
templateZh: 正俯拍鸟瞰视角，画面从正上方垂直向下呈现。【平面视角下的场景内容，注意描述布局和色彩分布】，【光线/时间】，【风格】。
templateEn: Top-down bird's-eye view, the frame presents the scene from directly overhead. [The scene laid out as a flat pattern — describe the layout and color distribution], [light / time of day], [style].
exampleZh: 正俯拍鸟瞰视角，画面从正上方垂直向下呈现。一个女孩躺在铺满各色鲜花的地面上，她穿着白裙闭眼微笑双臂张开，周围是红玫瑰白百合黄向日葵，阳光从正上方照射没有阴影，色彩浓烈饱满，视觉冲击力强，杂志大片感。
exampleEn: Top-down bird's-eye view, the frame presents the scene from directly overhead. A girl lies on a ground covered in flowers of every color — white dress, eyes closed, smiling, arms spread open — surrounded by red roses, white lilies and yellow sunflowers; sunlight falls from directly above casting no shadows, saturated and vivid color, strong visual impact, magazine-editorial feel.
lesson: Top-down turns the world into pattern: people become composition, food becomes color wheels. When writing bird's-eye prompts describe layout and color distribution (red left, yellow right) and the AI arranges a prettier frame.

name: Spielberg-Style Facial Reaction Shot
nameAlt: 斯皮尔伯格式面部反应镜头
plain: The frame pushes slowly into a character's face from a slightly low angle; their eyes fix on something off-screen (never shown) while the expression slowly shifts — awe, fear, or speechless wonder. You never see the thing, but the reaction pulls you in anyway.
when: Buildup before a reveal, characters facing spectacle, emotional-impact close-ups
templateZh: 斯皮尔伯格式反应镜头。略微仰拍角度，缓慢推近至【角色】面部特写。【角色】的目光注视着画面外【某个方向】的某个东西（不出现在画面中），表情从【初始情绪】缓缓变为【最终情绪】，嘴唇微微张开，【光线描述：通常是来自角色注视方向的光打在脸上】，【情绪氛围】。
templateEn: Spielberg-style reaction shot. From a slightly low angle, the camera pushes in slowly to a close-up of [character]'s face. [Character]'s gaze is fixed on something [direction] off-screen (never shown), the expression turning slowly from [initial emotion] to [final emotion], lips parting slightly, [light: usually falling from the direction the character stares], [emotional atmosphere].
exampleZh: 斯皮尔伯格式反应镜头。略微仰拍角度，缓慢推近至小男孩面部特写。他的目光注视着画面上方远处的某个东西（不出现在画面中），表情从好奇缓缓变为无法置信的惊叹，嘴巴越张越大眼睛出现不可思议的眼神，来自他注视方向的温暖金色光线照亮了他的脸，管弦乐渐强的史诗感。
exampleEn: Spielberg-style reaction shot. From a slightly low angle, the camera pushes in slowly to a close-up of a little boy's face. His gaze is fixed on something far above, off-screen (never shown), his expression turning slowly from curiosity to incredulous wonder, mouth falling open wider and wider, an astonished light in his eyes; warm golden light from where he stares illuminates his face, a swelling orchestral sense of awe.
lesson: To make viewers curious, withhold the answer: shoot only the expression of seeing, never the thing seen. The blank space grips harder than any reveal — Hitchcock explained the principle; Spielberg monetized it for half a century.

name: Wong Kar-wai-Style Slow-Motion Shot
plain: The frame feels strangely fast-yet-slow — everyday actions (walking, drinking, lighting a cigarette) stretched until every frame has ceremony, occasionally stuttering into a broken rhythm, bathed in saturated red-green-blue neon: instant "lonely urbanite" flavor.
when: Urban night stories, loneliness, ambiguous atmosphere, artsy tone
templateZh: 王家卫式影像风格。【手持/跟随】镜头，画面有轻微晃动和抽帧跳跃感。【角色的日常动作】被慢速呈现，每个动作细节被放大拉长。【高饱和的霓虹色调描述】，颗粒感胶片质感，【环境描述】，孤独而迷人的都市氛围。
templateEn: Wong Kar-wai-style imagery. [Handheld / follow] shot, the frame swaying slightly with stuttering frame-skips. [The character's everyday action] rendered in slow motion, every small gesture stretched and enlarged. [Highly saturated neon color description], grainy film texture, [environment], a lonely yet mesmerizing urban mood.
exampleZh: 王家卫式影像风格。跟随镜头，画面有轻微晃动和抽帧跳跃感。女人穿着旗袍在深夜的走廊里端着保温壶缓缓走过的身影被慢速呈现，旗袍上的花纹在昏暗的灯光下若隐若现，墙壁被染上红绿霓虹灯的混合色调，颗粒感胶片质感，潮湿的走廊墙面反射着微光，孤独而迷人的都市氛围。
exampleEn: Wong Kar-wai-style imagery. Follow shot, the frame swaying slightly with stuttering frame-skips. A woman in a qipao carrying a thermos walks slowly down a late-night corridor, rendered in slow motion; the pattern on the qipao flickers in the dim light, the walls stained in mixed red-and-green neon, grainy film texture, the damp corridor walls glinting with faint reflections — a lonely yet mesmerizing urban mood.
lesson: The Wong Kar-wai formula = everyday action + slow motion + red-green neon. The fast-yet-slow secret is stuttering frame-skips. For urban night stories, apply the trio directly.
directorNote: Follow / handheld + slow motion + saturated color

name: Wes Anderson-Style Symmetrical Shot
nameAlt: 韦斯·安德森式对称构图运镜
plain: The frame looks measured with a ruler: the character dead center, objects on both sides nearly mirrored, color unified to the extreme — sometimes only pink and butter-yellow exist. Even pans keep this obsessive symmetry in every frame.
when: Storybook scenes, retro spaces, witty polished ads or title sequences
templateZh: 韦斯·安德森式对称构图。【固定镜头/水平摇镜】，画面严格中轴对称。【人物站在正中央的描述】，左右两侧【镜像对称的物品/空间】，整体色调统一为【马卡龙色系/某个统一的色调】，构图精确工整如同建筑制图，童话般的精致感。
templateEn: Wes Anderson-style symmetrical composition. [Static shot / horizontal pan], the frame strictly symmetrical about its central axis. [Description of the character standing dead center], with [mirror-symmetric objects / spaces] on both sides, the overall palette unified into [macaron pastels / one unified tone], composition as precise as an architectural drawing, storybook refinement.
exampleZh: 韦斯·安德森式对称构图。固定镜头，画面严格中轴对称。穿粉色制服的电梯服务员面无表情地站在正中央，双手交叠在身前，左右两侧是完全镜像的大理石墙壁和黄铜把手，电梯内部整体色调统一为薄荷绿配奶油白，构图精确工整如同建筑制图，复古而精致的童话酒店感。
exampleEn: Wes Anderson-style symmetrical composition. Static shot, the frame strictly symmetrical about its central axis. An elevator attendant in a pink uniform stands expressionless at dead center, hands folded in front; on both sides, perfectly mirrored marble walls and brass handles, the elevator's interior unified in mint green and cream white, composition as precise as an architectural drawing, a refined vintage storybook-hotel feel.
lesson: Obsessive symmetry = instantly memorable. Say strictly symmetrical and centered composition outright, describe both sides as mirrored, and the AI will line everything up neatly.
directorNote: Static shot + strict central-axis symmetry + horizontal pan (gliding through a perfectly symmetrical space)

name: Nolan-Style Cross-Timeline Shot
plain: Suggests two timelines / viewpoints happening simultaneously in one clip. Tone differences (warm amber past vs. cold blue present) and opposing camera directions (one pushing, one pulling) weave a sense of parallel timelines intertwining.
when: Memory vs. reality, dual storylines, fate, contrast montage
templateZh: 诺兰式时空交叉感。画面在两个时空之间交替呈现：【时空A描述，色调偏暖/冷】，画面【推进/拉远】；切换到【时空B描述，色调相反】，画面【相反方向运动】。两个画面通过【某种视觉共同元素】产生关联，时空交错，宿命感。
templateEn: Nolan-style cross-timeline feel. The frame alternates between two timelines: [timeline A described, warm/cool tone], the camera [pushing in / pulling back]; cut to [timeline B described, opposite tone], the camera moving [the opposite way]. The two images are linked by [a shared visual element], timelines interweaving, a sense of fate.
exampleZh: 诺兰式时空交叉感。画面在两个时空之间交替呈现：年轻士兵在金黄色调的麦田里奔跑，画面向前推进追随他的背影；切换到同一个人年老后坐在冷蓝色调的病房里缓缓抬起手，画面向后拉远展示整个空荡的房间。两个画面通过他始终伸出的那只手产生关联——年轻时在够麦穗、年老时在够窗外的阳光，时空交错，宿命感。
exampleEn: Nolan-style cross-timeline feel. The frame alternates between two timelines: a young soldier runs through a golden wheat field, the camera pushing forward after his back; cut to the same man decades later in a cold-blue hospital room slowly raising his hand, the camera pulling back to reveal the empty room. The two images are linked by that outstretched hand — young, reaching for the wheat; old, reaching for the sunlight outside the window — timelines interweaving, a sense of fate.
lesson: Two timelines, two tones (warm = past, cold = present), plus a push-vs-pull contrast — viewers instantly read "two threads." Highest value-for-effort move for cinematic short videos.
directorNote: Cross-cutting suggestion + alternating push/pull + tone contrast separating the timelines

name: Tarkovsky-Style Long-Take Wander
nameAlt: 塔可夫斯基式长镜头漫游
plain: So slow you think the video froze — yet that extremity of slowness turns every detail (water stains, windowsill dust, swaying sheer curtains) into a character. Not telling a story; feeling the breath of a space.
when: Atmospheric empty shots, memory and time, poetic solitude, slow-paced openings
templateZh: 极缓慢的一镜到底漫游。画面以极慢的速度从【起点】开始平缓移动，经过【充满细节的环境描写：水渍、灰尘、光线、植物、陈旧痕迹】，【自然声音提示：雨声/风声/水滴声/远处钟声】，整个画面沉浸在【某种光线质感】中，凝视感，诗意的孤独。
templateEn: An extremely slow one-take wander. The frame drifts at an extremely slow pace from [starting point], past [an environment dense with detail: water stains, dust, light, plants, marks of age], [ambient sound cues: rain / wind / dripping water / a distant bell], the whole frame steeped in [a certain quality of light], a meditative gaze, poetic solitude.
exampleZh: 极缓慢的一镜到底漫游。画面以极慢的速度从一间废弃教堂的彩色玻璃窗开始平缓移动，光线透过彩窗在石头地面上投下红蓝紫色的光斑，经过积满灰尘的木质长椅、一根燃到只剩半截的蜡烛正在缓缓熄灭最后的火苗摇曳、石壁上长出的青苔和蕨类植物，远处有微弱的雨水滴落在石板上的回响声，整个画面沉浸在潮湿的弱光中，凝视感，诗意的孤独和时间的重量。
exampleEn: An extremely slow one-take wander. The frame drifts at an extremely slow pace from the stained-glass window of an abandoned church, light falling in red, blue and violet pools across the stone floor; past dust-furred wooden pews, a candle burned to a half stub flickering toward its end, moss and ferns rooted in the stone walls, and somewhere far off the faint echo of raindrops on stone slabs, the whole frame steeped in damp low light — a meditative gaze, poetic solitude and the weight of time.
lesson: Slowness taken to the extreme makes details the protagonists: stains, dust, candle flames, moss all "act." For empty shots and mood pieces, write extremely slow, list three to five aged details, and the arthouse feel arrives on its own.
directorNote: Extremely slow long take + follow / lateral drift + dense environmental detail + ambient sound cues
